newsitem.title: USA: Mutual fund assets rose in latest week - ICI.
newsitem.headline: Mutual fund assets rose in latest week - ICI.

text.p: Total money market mutual fund assets in the week ended Aug. 14 rose to $1.02 trillion from $1.01 trillion the prior week, an industry trade group said Thursday.
The Investment Company Institute said assets of the nation's 678 retail money market mutual funds rose $5.16 billion to $673.46 billion in the week.

Of the retail funds, assets of the 404 taxable money market funds rose $5.05 billion to $551.64 billion, while assets of the 274 tax-exempt funds rose $105.3 million to $121.82 billion, the group said.

ICI said assets of the 330 institutional money market funds rose $1.76 billion to $345.85 billion. Of these, assets of the 267 taxable money market funds rose $2.35 billion to $309.75 billion, while assets of the 63 tax-exempt funds fell $592.4 million to $36.10 billion, it said.
